title: A06 G1 CPU accounting: settle final Task runtime after Process weak-reference teardown
body:
## Source-grounded G1 correctness blocker — not yet reproduced as QEMU undercharge

Current A06 `kernel/asterinas/kernel/core/src/fs/fs_impls/cgroupfs/controller/cpu.rs` (inspected blob `45d93fe11506e6f6813142de1012352b958a5897`) implements `charge_task_cpu(task, from, until)` by `thread.weak_process().upgrade()`; when the Process Arc is already gone, it **returns without charging any positive pending CPU interval**. This avoids the earlier SMP `unwrap(None)` panic, but may lose final scheduler runtime and undercount the original cgroup and its ancestors for short-lived tasks.

This is a concrete source-level accounting/lifetime concern, **not a demonstrated quota-bypass exploit**. The owner's 153/153 kernel tests and 2vCPU guest results do not isolate final per-task debit after Process destruction.

### Required A06 correction and exact validation
- Retain a strong reference to the *original* accounting cgroup/ResourceDomain through task exit or settle current runtime before Process ownership disappears. Do not guess a replacement domain or build a second ResourceDomain/ledger.
- Debit `[from, until)` once, bounded and IRQ-safe, across preemption, task exit, dequeue and reaping, including shared ancestor, FIFO/fair and 100ms boundary.
- Add a deterministic negative regression for `Weak<Process>` being dead with pending CPU runtime, plus disposable 1vCPU and 2vCPU high-rate worker/fork/exit QEMU workloads checking actual cpu.stat versus independent process/guest CPU consumption and no panic.
- Keep A06 [Draft #18](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/trillionnium-os-desktop/pull/18) unqualified for G1 until proven and connected to A05 genuine CapSpace. No production host cgroup/firmware/disk changes.

A00 reported the source path and requirement in #18 review; this issue tracks the executable negative acceptance, not an additional administrative gate.
